Flow.description: Retail Cycle - Quote status now walks automatically with the deal instead of sitting at Draft forever (found live: every Quote in the org was stuck at Draft). This before-save flow covers the Draft -> Presented transition: the moment a Quote is marked as the Opportunity's synced (primary) Quote is the real "Commit" moment in the cycle, so that's when it stops being just a draft working number. The Accepted transition (Reservation created against this Quote) and the Denied transition (deal Closed Lost/Cancelled) are handled by separate flows closer to those real trigger points - see AF_FL_Reservation_SyncQuoteAccepted and AF_FL_Opp_DenyQuoteOnLostOrCancel.
Flow.label: Quote Status Follows Cycle
